type: Engineering Style Technical Mind Map (Radial Mind Map)
goal: Generate a mind map of the Kubernetes system, with 'Kubernetes Platform Engineering' at the center, covering six primary domains: architecture, workloads, networking, security, storage, delivery, and SRE observability, emphasizing CNCF component names in English, with Chinese explanations that can be mixed for secondary nodes.

canvas.background: deep slate #0F172A with subtle 1px grid #1E293B at 32px spacing

title_strip.title: Kubernetes knowledge lineage (platform and SRE)
title_strip.subtitle: 1.30+ Release Line · Production-oriented
title_strip.position: top-left, JetBrains Mono / SF Mono, light gray

central_node.label:
Kubernetes
Platform
central_node.position: Geometric center slightly above, reserved white space for bottom legend

primary_branches.connector_style: 2px curve, connecting from the center to each primary, color = branch color

B1: etcd backup: snapshot interval + cross-region disaster recovery
Upgrade strategy: in-place small version / blue-green large version
B2: Pod / Deployment / StatefulSet / DaemonSet / Job Lifecycle
HPA v2, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler linkage and noise suppression
Resource model: request/limit, QoS class, cpuset/NUMA
B3: CNI Comparison: Cilium (eBPF) / Calico, NetworkPolicy Default Deny
Service / EndpointSlice, Headless Friendly with gRPC
Gateway API replaces Ingress routing and TLS layering
CoreDNS and External Cluster DNS/PrivateLink Coordination
B4: OPA Gatekeeper / Kyverno policy as code
Mirrored supply chain: cosign verification, private Harbor, SBOM scanning
B5: CSI Plugin: EBS / Cloud Disk Snapshot Policy
StorageClass Dynamic Provisioning and Topology Awareness (Region/AZ)
Stateful workloads with volume resize / snapshot
Temporary storage: emptyDir limit and local SSD
B6: Argo CD / Flux: ApplicationSet, Multi-Cluster Bootstrap
Prometheus + Thanos / Mimir, Recording Rule Noise Reduction
Log: Loki / sidecar collection, KPI: apiserver latency, etcd fysnc, control plane SLO

tertiary_nodes.rule: Only hang 2 small leaves below 'OpenTelemetry' in B6: 'Collector pipeline' and 'trace → logs linkage', lines thinner at 1px, to avoid expanding other domains.

must_know.rule: Star markers '★ Cilium', '★ Gateway API', '★ OPA / Kyverno' and '★ Argo CD'

legend.content: Color → Six major platform domains; ★ → New cluster landing is a must; B6 has unique tertiary expansion allowed

must_keep: Hexa-main branches arranged in equal angles, connecting lines do not cover text
Service name/component name clearly discernible in English (Cilium, Gateway API, Argo CD, Prometheus)
Node hierarchy and font size steps are clear
avoid: K8s logo large sticker (text title can be substituted)
More than 2 tertiaries will cause the entire image to bloom
